key_insight: Two-level overlapping Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and RGDSW coarse spaces remain robust for high-order 2D FEM/VEM Poisson problems, while RGDSW cuts coarse-space size substantially with similar solver performance.
engineering_relevance: This gives scalable preconditioning options for high-order discretizations, helping keep iterative solves efficient as polynomial order increases.
method: Built two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW and RGDSW coarse spaces.
Analyzed conforming Pk and Qk FEM with a condition number bound that depends explicitly on polynomial degree k.
Tested on structured triangular/quadrilateral FEM meshes and polygonal VEM meshes for the 2D Poisson problem.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments up to polynomial degree k=9 show scalability, with RGDSW reducing the coarse problem dimension by about a factor of three while keeping competitive iteration counts.
watch_item: Performance and robustness are shown for selected high-order degrees and 2D Poisson test cases, so behavior for more complex PDEs, 3D, or highly irregular meshes may need separate validation.
paper_title: Two-level additive Schwarz preconditioners with GDSW coarse spaces for high-order discretizations in 2D
